results.title: Full Stack Developer (Java / Spring Boot & Angular) – Full Remote
results.description:
**Chi siamo**

Entra in AGAP2 Italia: lavorerai in un contesto internazionale e collaborativo, con progetti in diversi settori e opportunità di contribuire a iniziative ingegneristiche e IT sfidanti. Parte del Gruppo MoOngy, AGAP2 è presente sul mercato europeo in 14 paesi con servizi di consulenza ingegneristica e IT. Dal 2018, agap2 Italia opera sul territorio nazionale nei seguenti settori: Automotive, Aerospace, Industrial Automation, Energy, Oil & Gas, Betting & Gaming, Fashion & Luxury, Finance, Healthcare.

**Il Ruolo**

Per un importante progetto evolutivo in ambito Pubblica Amministrazione focalizzato sullo sviluppo di piattaforme gestionali, cerchiamo uno Sviluppatore Full Stack (livello Middle / Senior). La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team strutturato contribuendo attivamente allo sviluppo sia lato backend che frontend.

**Cosa farai**

- Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere funzionalità end-to-end su applicativi gestionali complessi per il settore della Pubblica Amministrazione.
- Sviluppare servizi backend scalabili e API RESTful utilizzando Java e il framework Spring Boot.
- Realizzare e ottimizzare interfacce utente moderne, responsive e performanti tramite framework Angular.
- Garantire la qualità del codice, l'affidabilità delle integrazioni e il rispetto delle best practice di sviluppo software.
- Collaborare quotidianamente in modalità agile con il team tecnico e gli stakeholder di progetto.

**Requisiti richiesti**

- **Esperienza:** Seniority di livello Middle o Senior nello sviluppo Full Stack su architetture web enterprise.
- **Competenze Backend:** Solida padronanza di **Java** e del framework **Spring Boot**.
- **Competenze Frontend:** Comprovata esperienza nello sviluppo con **Angular** (TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3).
- **Sede di lavoro:** Full Remote (100% da remoto su territorio italiano).

**Offerta e Inquadramento**

*La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 30.000 EUR e 45.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. Oltre all'assunzione diretta, per questa posizione valutiamo positivamente anche collaborazioni in regime di libera professione (Partita IVA), con tariffa economica da concordare in base alla reale seniority del profilo.*

results.title: Full Stack developer (Java/ Angular/ React)
results.description:
**CHI SIAMO**

**ADENTIS Italia** è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy.

Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 8.500 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da quattro anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO e VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO, il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto.

Ruolo: **Full Stack developer (Java/ Angular/ React)**

Luogo: **Vimodrone**

Modalità: **ibrido**

**IL TUO RUOLO**

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una **Full Stack developer (Java/ Angular/ React)** con esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni moderne, scalabili e orientate ai microservizi. La figura entrerà a far parte di un team tecnico dinamico occupandosi dell’analisi, progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni enterprise ad alte prestazioni.

**Responsabilità principali:**

- Progettare e sviluppare applicazioni backend utilizzando le ultime versioni di Java.
- Realizzare servizi REST e architetture a microservizi con framework Spring.
- Sviluppare interfacce web moderne e responsive utilizzando React e Angular.
- Integrare sistemi di messaggistica e comunicazione asincrona come NATS o tecnologie equivalenti.
- Collaborare con team cross-funzionali seguendo metodologie Agile/Scrum.
- Garantire qualità del codice tramite testing, code review e best practice di sviluppo.
- Contribuire all’evoluzione architetturale delle piattaforme software.

**Requisiti tecnici**

- Esperienza di almeno **4 anni** con **Java** (ultime versioni)
- Esperienza consolidata con:

**Spring Boot**

**Spring MVC**

**Spring Security**

**API REST**

- Esperienza nello sviluppo frontend con:

React

Angular

HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript, JavaScript

- Conoscenza di sistemi di messaggistica/event streaming come:

NATS

Kafka

RabbitMQ

MQTT o equivalenti

- Familiarità con architetture microservizi e sistemi distribuiti.
- Esperienza con database relazionali e NoSQL.
- Conoscenza di Git, CI/CD e strumenti DevOps.
- Gradita esperienza con Docker e Kubernetes.

**Cosa offriamo**

- Contratto a tempo indeterminato o collaborazione in partita iva.
- Percorsi di formazione continua su hard e soft skill.
- Piano di crescita professionale strutturato.
- Coinvolgimento in progetti innovativi ad alto contenuto tecnologico.

La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra **30.000** EUR e **35.000** EUR.

La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società*.*

*Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna.*

**The world needs you**

**ADENTIS Italia** è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile.

Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99.

*I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.*

results.title: Full-Stack Developer – Medical Device Software (m/f/d) – funded by the EXIST start-up grant
results.description:
**After this autumn, Ynone pitched at Web Summit in Lisbon (selected among 105 startups in the Impact category) and at Frontiers Health in Berlin, and presented at the smartXhealth Summit in Freiburg. Now we're growing the team.**

At Ynone, we're building a digital companion app for people living with lymphoedema. Patients organise their daily therapy (routine, measurements, compression, reminders) and bring structured reports to their doctor's appointments. Our AI assistant Ida answers self-management questions in five languages.

Next comes Ynone Scan: smartphone-based limb measurement for arms and legs, to be clinically validated and certified as a medical device (MDR Class IIa).

We work with Charité, the Földiklinik and Uniklinik Bonn, and are part of the Vision Health Pioneers incubator.

**💡 THE OPPORTUNITY**

We're applying for the EXIST start-up grant (EXIST-Gründungsstipendium) with Charité as our mentor, with a planned start in April 2027. We're looking for a full-stack developer to join our EXIST team.

→ 12 months of EXIST stipend (€2,500/month with a university degree, €3,000 with a PhD, plus €150 per child)

→ The chance to build a medical device from day one, with real impact for patients

→ A long-term role in the company after the funding period

**🛠 YOUR ROLE**

• Build the native app for iOS and Android together with our CTO, integrating Ynone Scan and Ida

• Develop frontend and backend features, from the user interface to APIs and database (AWS)

• Work in a software life cycle according to IEC 62304, with clean code, tests and documentation

• Help make data protection and security (GDPR) the foundation of the platform

• Contribute to technical documentation for the MDR certification path

• Support the clinical validation study with Charité and turn feedback from patients and doctors into product improvements

✅ WHAT YOU BRING

• Full-stack development experience, ideally with React Native, TypeScript and Python

• Experience with databases and cloud services (e.g. PostgreSQL, AWS) is a plus

• A genuine interest in medical technology and digital health

• Fluent English; German (at least B1) is a plus

• The drive to work full time in a start-up with social impact

🌱 NO MDR EXPERIENCE YET? APPLY ANYWAY

You don't need to be a regulatory expert. What matters is your motivation to work on a medical device and, ideally, a first experience in medtech or healthcare: an internship, a thesis, a university or side project. We'll build the regulatory know-how together, with dedicated coaching from the EXIST budget and support from our clinical and incubator network.

**🎓 EXIST ELIGIBILITY**

• University degree (Bachelor's, Master's or PhD) obtained no more than 5 years ago, or at least 50% of your studies completed

• Full-time commitment for 12 months, starting April 2027

• Based in Berlin

**📅 TIMELINE**

We want to finalise the team by 14 December 2026, so please reach out as soon as possible: send me a DM or write to marasorrentino@ynone.eu.

**👥 THE TEAM**

Mara Sorrentino (Founder, Lead Product Design & Business, and caregiver), Claudio Cortese (CTO) and Prajjwal Yadav (Founding ML Engineer), supported by specialists in lymphology.

Know someone who fits? Please share or tag them 🙏

www.ynone.eu

#FullStack #Hiring #EXIST #MedTech #DigitalHealth #MDR #IEC62304 #Berlin #Startup #Lymphedema

results.title: Full Stack Data Engineer
results.description:
***At Save the Children Australia, we’re not just crunching numbers, we’re using data to change lives. Every platform we improve, solution we build, and insight we enable helps deliver programs that protect, educate and empower children across Australia and the Pacific.***

***We’re looking for a Full Stack Data Engineer who is equal parts builder, problem-solver and innovator. Someone who wants their code to do more than power products. Here, you’ll help build the data, knowledge and AI foundations that power purpose.***

**What you’ll be doing:**

In this full time, permanent role, ideally based in our Melbourne head office\*, you’ll work as a part of our Technology team in Melbourne to help us create lasting change for children everywhere.

You’ll be lending your skills in the following areas:

- **Pipeline wizardry:** Design scalable, maintainable, **metadata-driven** and automated data solutions that make future-you proud.
- **Engineering discipline:** Bring **Git, CI/CD, testing** and software engineering **best practices** to our platforms and workflows because hacky scripts won’t cut it.
- **Stakeholder whisperer:** Work with people across the organisation to turn messy requirements into clear, testable specifications and **elegant,** maintainable solutions that simply work.
- **Analytics enabler:** Build and evolve analytical assets, **semantic models** and reusable data products that support reporting, insights and decision-making.
- **Data guardian:** Keep our data **secure, compliant and trustworthy**, using automated, code-driven controls. Protecting sensitive information is part of protecting children.
- **Future shaper:** Help evolve our data, knowledge and AI capabilities, including the central registries and metadata that people and AI agents rely on, so we’re ready for the opportunities and challenges ahead.
- **Human in the loop:** Work with AI coding agents as part of how we build: specify, direct and review the work, and keep the tests, guardrails and separate environments that make changes safe to ship.
- **Ops ninja:** Promote **DataOps principles**, automation, agility and reliability everywhere you can.
- **Integration smarts:** Design and maintain clean integrations and databases that just work.

**About you:**

You care about quality code, but you also care about **impact**. You enjoy solving complex problems through thoughtful engineering, automation and good architecture. You’re curious about how data, AI and software engineering can be combined to create systems that are scalable, maintainable and genuinely useful. Most importantly, you’re motivated by knowing that your work helps create better outcomes for children.

**Must-haves:**

- Around five years or more as a code-focused data engineer, building efficient, maintainable pipelines in **Python** and SQL. Strong engineers proficient in other languages and keen to learn Python will also be considered.
- Solid understanding of **data modelling**, and a genuine interest in abstraction, architecture and reducing complexity through reusable patterns.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, code review and CI/CD.
- Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to follow and reason about complex ideas quickly.
- Collaborative, able to explain technical ideas in plain **language** and take end-to-end ownership of outcomes across business and technical stakeholders.
- Bring curiosity, humility, and a learning mindset, asking questions, embracing feedback, and adopting new ways of working, including AI-assisted engineering, while keeping ownership of architecture, quality and outcomes.

**Bonus points for:**

- Experience with dbt.
- Experience with **Microsoft Fabric** or other modern cloud data platforms, including lakehouse architecture.
- Experience with metadata-driven pipelines.
- Experience developing reports, dashboards, visualisations, semantic models or analytical products (e.g. Power BI or similar).
- Exposure to DataOps, platform engineering or infrastructure-as-code approaches, including environment design, automated deployment of changes and automated data tests within pipelines.
- Interest in metadata, knowledge architecture, semantics, open standards or machine-readable systems.
- Interest or experience in **data science,** machine learning, advanced analytics, **predictive analytics** or AI engineering.

**A place to belong:**

We see and celebrate the unique value you bring to our organisation, and offer a range of rewards for your effort, including:

- Opportunity to work on additional projects to enable you to stretch and feel connected to programs in a different way.
- A modern, up to date working space, or the opportunity to work from home (WFH), or both!
- Support for workplace wellness, including access to our free, confidential Employee Wellbeing Program.
- Celebrate and feel supported in your diversity. We’ve established internal networks to support our diverse workforce, foster inclusion and allow you to bring your whole self to work (if that’s what you want!) (Pride@Save, Parents and Carers@Save, Mental Wellness Alliance, Disability@Save, First Nations Advisory Committee).
- Full salary packaging benefits (please visit: www.salarypackagingplus.com.au to see how much this benefit could mean to you!)
- Extra leave to use in a range of ways to ensure you’re able to perform at your optimum.

For more information about our employee benefits or a career at Save, visit our **Careers Page**: https://www.savethechildren.org.au/about-us/careers/

**Does this sound like the place for you?**

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your cover letter and resume below.

*We strongly encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates to apply.*

Applications close **COB Monday 7 December 2027**

View the **Position Description** attached below or visit: https://www.savethechildren.org.au/about-us/careers/#jobs and search for this opportunity.

*\*We understand the need for work-life balance. We've advertised this role as full time permanent, but if you're looking for something different, please let us know. We offer flexible hours, remote working, and individual flexibility plans to ensure we’re providing you a personalised career.*

*We have tested our application process with diverse groups in mind, with the intent to ensure it's straightforward and accessible for all to apply. Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our culture and improve our ability to reach our most vulnerable client groups. But we also know there is no one-size fits-all when it comes to recruitment - so if we didn’t quite hit the mark for you, please let us know at people.culture@savethechildren.org.au. We’re dedicated to ensuring Save the Children Australia is a place where everyone can feel supported – no matter your race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexuality, neurodiversity, culture and beliefs.*

*Save the Children Australia is a child-safe organisation. All employees are required to undergo a National Police Check, a Working with Children Check, and sign our Child Safeguarding Policy and Code of Conduct. We also support the Inter-Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme.*

*Save the Children is committed to providing and maintaining a safe working environment for its employees and client groups, consistent with our obligations under OH&S legislation.*

*If you are having any issues with uploading your application for this role, please contact people.culture@savethechildren.org.au for further support.*

results.title: Full Time Overnights & Occasional Day Shifts | Pediatric RNs/LPNs | Princeton
results.description:
**Small Patients. Big Impact.**

At **Pediatric Home Service (PHS)**, we exist so kids can be kids. For more than 35 years, we've helped children with medical complexities receive the care they need where they thrive most: at home.

As a PHS nurse, you're more than a caregiver. You're a trusted part of a child's world. You'll be there for the everyday moments, milestones, victories, and challenges that matter most, helping children stay where they belong: surrounded by family, comfort, and the life they deserve.

**One nurse. One patient. A relationship that lasts years, not days.**

**Position Details**

- **Location: Princeton, MN (55371)**
- **Hours: 12-hour shifts**
  
  - **Days:**
    
    - **Every other** Saturday
  - **Overnights:**
    
    - **Every** Monday &
    - **Every other** Tuesday, Thursday, Friday & Saturdays
- **Client Specifics:** 12-years old with a g-tube

**What You'll Do**

- Provide skilled nursing care in home and school settings
- Assess and monitor your patient's condition and communicate changes with the care team
- Administer medications, treatments, and prescribed therapies
- Provide trach, ventilator, airway, and G-tube care as needed
- Maintain accurate documentation and support families through education
- Follow individualized care plans and maintain a safe care environment

**Why Nurses Choose PHS**

Here, you'll find something different: meaningful relationships, complex pediatric care, and a team that supports you every step of the way.

- No Pediatric Home Care Experience Required: Build confidence through hands-on education, patient-specific training, simulation-based learning where available, and 24/7 clinical support.
- 100% Pediatric Focus: Every patient, every shift, every skill is dedicated to caring for children.
- Grow Your Clinical Expertise: Strengthen your skills while caring for medically complex patients.
- Build Lasting Connections: Follow your patients' journeys and celebrate milestones alongside their families.
- Meaningful Work Without the Rush: Focus on quality, one-on-one care instead of juggling multiple patient assignments.
- Flexibility That Fits Your Life: Choose scheduling opportunities that work with your life.

**Benefits**

We want you to feel supported both at work and outside of it. Benefits may include:

- Generous PTO for full-time employees
- Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
- 401(k) Matching
- Tuition Reimbursement
- Professional Development & Learning Opportunities
- Flexible Scheduling
- Company-Paid Life Insurance
- A supportive environment where your work directly impacts children and families

**Earn More for Select Shifts**

Your flexibility makes a difference, and we believe it should be rewarded.

- Weekday Nights (Mon–Fri): +$1/hour
- Weekend Nights (Sat–Sun): +$2/hour
- Weekend Days (Sat–Sun): +$1/hour

**Pay Range**

You bring the skill and compassion that make one-on-one pediatric care possible. We’re committed to recognizing the experience and expertise you bring to our families.

- **LPN: $25.00 – $31.00/hour**
- **RN: $35.00 – $41.00/hour**

**Starting pay is based on license, relevant experience, and qualifications.**

**Your Work Changes Lives**

Most organizations talk about making a difference. At PHS, you can see it.

You see it in a child sleeping in their own bed instead of a hospital room. In a family enjoying dinner together. In milestones reached because someone showed up with both skill and compassion. **That someone could be you.**

**Apply today and discover why nurses choose Pediatric Home Service to build meaningful careers and make a lasting impact.**

**Follow Us**

- Facebook: Pediatric Home Service Careers - Minnesota
- Instagram: @PHSKidsHomeCare

**About Us**

Pediatric Home Service (PHS): Since 1990, PHS has helped medically complex children thrive at home, school, and in their communities through high-quality pediatric nursing and DME services.

*Pediatric Home Service is an equal opportunity employer; we are committed to affirmative action and equal employment opportunities for all regardless of protected veteran status, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation or identity, disability, age, marital status, familial status, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, or status with regard to public assistance.*

Ledgebrook is an AI-native specialty insurance platform. When a business needs coverage that is custom and complex, its broker comes to us, and our underwriters give them an answer, often in hours rather than weeks.

We are insurance industry insiders, and we eat our own cooking: Ledgebrook writes the policy and shares the risk through our own carrier, Ledgebrook Specialty, rated A- (Excellent) by AM Best. We work exclusively through wholesale brokers.

Talent density is our north star—fewer, better people working together as one. To that end we’ve replaced all individual incentives with generous equity packages—we play as a team, we win as a team. results.title: Full-Time Peer Recovery Specialist
results.description:
Who We Are:

Santé Group Companies prides itself in being a leader in community-based behavioral and mental health services. Our track record of innovation and growth reflects our ability to deliver diverse and highly individualized services. We have a passion for providing empathetic and potentially life-saving care to help individuals heal, recover, and thrive, as well as live their lives in a manner that allows them to fully integrate in the community. The Santé Group aspires to create an organization that places value on collaboration, innovation, creativity, and inclusiveness. To achieve this success, it is essential that all members of our organization feel secure, welcome, and respected. All members of our organization have a responsibility to uphold these values.

What We’re Looking For:

Santé is seeking a **Full-Time** **Peer Recovery Specialists (in office)** to join our frontline crisis intervention team in **Centreville,** **MD**. **The available shift is 4:00PM to 12:00AM.** As a Peer Recovery Specialist, you will assess, evaluate, and perform crisis intervention techniques, and will develop a crisis plan for continuation of services related to individual clients. He or she will be responsible for all incident documentation and will be the on-site resource for any relevant clinical information, as well as the liaison for collaboration with other involved parties including families, friends, and other community providers (all under clinical supervision of an LCSW-C/LCPC). **Not a remote position.**

What You’ll Do:

- Assist in performing a danger assessment, a crisis assessment, an environmental assessment upon entry to the community situation and lethality assessment
- Assist in performing an on-scene assessment and treatment plan
- Effectively perform crisis intervention including de-escalation, crisis planning and implementation
- Design appropriate referral recommendations using available community resources
- Address population of child, adolescent, adult, dual-diagnosis, co-occurring and elderly
- Work with families and involved persons to de-escalate the situation, make a crisis plan, and enlist cooperation with recommended treatment
- Document interactions using CRS procedures
- Must be able to work with first responders and be aware of first responder culture
- Must familiarize oneself with police codes and language
- Participate in and complete all required trainings
- Provide education in the community about the agency and all components of CRS when needed
- Check work e-mail at the beginning and end of each shift
- Provide mentoring to interns and new staff
- Other duties as assigned

What We Require:

- Peer recovery certification
- High School Diploma or equivalent and at least one (1) year professional experience (experience working with children and families in a community-based program preferred).
- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to drive a company vehicle. The employee must possess a valid Driver’s License, proof of current automobile insurance and may not have more than two (2) points on their driving record.

What You’ll Get:

- Pay Range: $20.50-$24.00 per hour
- No cost supervision for Peer Recovery certification.
- Opportunities for career growth, training and development, flexible work schedules and shifts.
- Company-wide wellness program.

We believe that diversity of background and experience makes for better problem-solving and collaboration, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team. Even more important than your resume is a positive attitude, a passion for making an impact, a personal desire to grow, and the ability to help individuals heal, recover, and thrive.

Disclaimers:

The Santé Group aspires to create an organization that places value on collaboration, innovation, creativity, and inclusiveness. To achieve this success, it is essential that all members of our organization feel secure, welcome, and respected. All members of our organization have a responsibility to uphold these values.

The Santé Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. The Santé Group participates in E-Verify.
